mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, market, status, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_at, peak_price, budget_allocated, exit_price, exit_reason, exit_at, dry_run, created_at FROM auto_trade_position WHERE status = 'HOLDING' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, symbol, market, status, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_at, peak_price, budget_allocated, exit_price, exit_reason, exit_at, dry_run, created_at FROM auto_trade_position ORDER BY id
SELECT id, symbol, market, status, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_at, peak_price, budget_allocated, exit_price, exit_reason, exit_at, dry_run, created_at FROM auto_trade_position WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auto_trade_position WHERE status = 'HOLDING'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_trade_position (symbol, market, status, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_at, peak_price, budget_allocated, dry_run, created_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, 'HOLDING', #{entryPrice}, #{entryQty}, #{entryAt}, #{peakPrice}, #{budgetAllocated}, #{dryRun}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE auto_trade_position SET peak_price = #{peakPrice} WHERE id = #{id}
